note: spoken != caption by design. The synthesizer needs phonetic spelling; the viewer must still read the real identifiers. Captions are burned in because judges watch muted.

scenes.caption: An autonomous agent finishes a job and says it was paid. Who checks?
scenes.spoken: An autonomous agent finishes a job, and says it was paid. Who checks?

scenes.caption: ERC-8004 answers with a Validation Registry. It names three things you can put in the validator slot: a human reviewer, a staked node, a TEE. All three are somebody you have to trust.
scenes.spoken: E R C eight thousand four answers with a validation registry. It names three things you can put in the validator slot. A human reviewer. A staked node. A trusted execution environment. All three are somebody you have to trust.

scenes.caption: But validatorAddress is just an address. An address can be a contract. And a contract does not need an opinion.
scenes.spoken: But validator address is just an address. An address can be a contract. And a contract does not need an opinion.

scenes.caption: Creditcoin's Attestcoin Protocol proves natively that a transaction was included in a finalized Ethereum block. No oracle operator.
scenes.spoken: Creditcoin's Attest coin protocol proves, natively, that a transaction was included in a finalized Ethereum block. No oracle operator.

scenes.caption: Here is what the block prover does not do. It does not check whether the transaction succeeded. A reverted payment is still in the block, and it proves exactly as well as a real one.
scenes.spoken: Here is what the block prover does not do. It does not check whether the transaction succeeded. A reverted payment is still in the block, and it proves exactly as well as a real one.

scenes.caption: These two USDC transfers sit in the same Ethereum block, 25,971,533. One moved 45 dollars. One reverted and moved nothing. Attestcoin returns true for both. Warrant returns 100, and 0.
scenes.spoken: These two U S D C transfers sit in the same Ethereum block. One moved forty five dollars. One reverted, and moved nothing. Attest coin returns true for both. Warrant returns one hundred, and zero.

scenes.caption: No keys. No stake. No quorum. Nothing to bribe, because there is nobody to bribe. Warrant is live on Creditcoin CC3.
scenes.spoken: No keys. No stake. No quorum. Nothing to bribe, because there is nobody to bribe. Warrant is live on Creditcoin, C C three.
